case_title: State of Madhya Pradesh v. Gangabishan @ Vishnu & Ors.
trial_court_outcome: Convicted under Sections 302/149, 325/149, 147, 148 and 440 of IPC
high_court_outcome: Acquitted all accused except accused No.1
neutral_facts: The accused and the victim were in a field watching crops when a dispute arose over cattle entering the field and damaging crops. The accused arrived with weapons, including a gun, and assaulted the victim, causing a gunshot injury to his left thigh. The victim's brother sustained injuries from blunt objects. The police recorded a FIR and conducted an inquest, including a post-mortem examination. The trial court convicted all accused under various IPC sections, but the High Court acquitted all except accused No.1, who was convicted under Section 304 (Part I) IPC. The High Court's decision was based on medical evidence indicating the accused did not have the intention to commit murder, but their actions caused bodily injury likely to result in death.
